newsitem.title: USA: DNX stake lifted by Biotechnology group.
newsitem.headline: DNX stake lifted by Biotechnology group.

text.p: A group including Value Fund L.P. said Tuesday it raised its stake in DNX Corp to 625,645 common shares or 7.27 percent from 5.9 percent previously held.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest purchases include a net of 78,000 common shares bought between Oct 9 and Nov 8 at prices ranging from $4.1250 and $5.6250 per share.
The group holds the stake for investment purposes, the filing said.
The Raritan, New Jersey, company is a contract research organization. The company's principal activities consist of preclinical drug development services.
